description: PostgreSQL row-lock / foreign-key cells. Each cell: run `ddl` then `seed` (autocommit), then the `steps` in order, each on its session (A, B: separate connections). A step whose session is still blocked runs as soon as that session's previous statement returns. A step with `when` runs only if the first value returned by the labeled step equals `firstValueEquals`. `focus` names the steps whose blocking and result are the cell's subject.

variants.base: users(id int primary key, name text); workspaces(id int primary key, owner_id int references users(id), name text)
variants.email: base plus users.email text UNIQUE (a key column that no foreign key references)
variants.cascade: base with workspaces.owner_id REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE; user 1 owns workspace 11
variants.deferred: base with workspaces.owner_id REFERENCES users(id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED
variants.nulls: users plus folders(id, owner_id references users, parent_id int, name, UNIQUE(owner_id, parent_id, name)) (NULLS DISTINCT, the default)

a_locks.none: SELECT id, name FROM users WHERE id = 1
a_locks.for_update: SELECT id FROM users WHERE id = 1 FOR UPDATE
a_locks.for_no_key_update: SELECT id FROM users WHERE id = 1 FOR NO KEY UPDATE
a_locks.for_share: SELECT id FROM users WHERE id = 1 FOR SHARE
a_locks.for_key_share: SELECT id FROM users WHERE id = 1 FOR KEY SHARE
a_locks.update_nonkey: UPDATE users SET name = 'a' WHERE id = 1
a_locks.update_key_id: UPDATE users SET id = 3 WHERE id = 1
a_locks.update_key_email: UPDATE users SET email = 'u1-new@x' WHERE id = 1
a_locks.update_key_email_same: UPDATE users SET email = 'u1@x', name = 'a' WHERE id = 1

b_actions.insert_child: INSERT INTO workspaces (id, owner_id, name) VALUES (20, 1, 'w20')
b_actions.update_child_fk: UPDATE workspaces SET owner_id = 1 WHERE id = 10
b_actions.for_key_share: SELECT id FROM users WHERE id = 1 FOR KEY SHARE
b_actions.for_share: SELECT id FROM users WHERE id = 1 FOR SHARE
b_actions.for_update: SELECT id FROM users WHERE id = 1 FOR UPDATE
b_actions.update_nonkey: UPDATE users SET name = 'b' WHERE id = 1
b_actions.child_update_name: UPDATE workspaces SET name = 'b' WHERE id = 11
b_actions.child_for_key_share: SELECT id FROM workspaces WHERE id = 11 FOR KEY SHARE

CREATE TABLE workspaces (id int PRIMARY KEY, owner_id int REFERENCES users(id), name text)
seed: INSERT INTO users (id, name) VALUES (1, 'u1'), (2, 'u2')
INSERT INTO workspaces (id, owner_id, name) VALUES (10, 2, 'w10')

steps.sql: SELECT id, name FROM users WHERE id = 1
steps.label: A.lock

steps.sql: INSERT INTO workspaces (id, owner_id, name) VALUES (20, 1, 'w20')
steps.label: B.action

cells.note: A and B at the same isolation level; B's snapshot is taken by B.action, after A.lock and before A ends.
